correctness.rationale: A cyclic 81-state transfer bijection counts every Roman labeling; the integer potential is checked on each of 601 allowed transitions, ensuring all reduced exponents are nonnegative. The exact entrywise identity B_0^3=B_0^7 and exact initial traces prove the all-order congruence formulas with the n=3 exception. Direct exhaustive Roman-neighborhood checks of 597780 labelings through n=6 independently corroborate, but are not substituted for, the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Counts of all optimal Roman defenses and the first off-optimum configurations are natural weight-enumerator coefficients not implied by the minimum alone. The explicit congruence laws with an n=3 exception and the 6n adjacent coefficient are obtained from a nontrivial 81-state periodicity certificate, creating a reproducible refinement of a familiar graph-family invariant, without claiming a closed full polynomial.
